subject.title: fix(infra): guard tailscale funnel status JSON parsing against non-JSON stdout

question: When `preserveFunnel` is enabled and Funnel status cannot be parsed, should startup preserve the unknown external state or continue by applying Serve?
rationale: The root policy treats fallback behavior as a product decision, and either choice trades external-route preservation against best-effort Serve availability.

options.title: Preserve on unknown
options.body: Keep parse failure distinct from false and skip Serve reconfiguration unless status positively proves no matching Funnel route exists.

options.title: Apply Serve best-effort
options.body: Intentionally map malformed status to false, accepting possible replacement of an external route and documenting that limitation.

recommendation.title: Preserve on unknown
recommendation.body: Keep parse failure distinct from false and skip Serve reconfiguration unless status positively proves no matching Funnel route exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Committed the original route-preservation feature and has the strongest visible history across the Tailscale infrastructure surface.
